stories.title: Iran MP says Tehran's missiles will strike Europe if US uses its bases
stories.summary: An Iranian MP told Euronews that Tehran's missiles would hit any European base used against it, as state media warned any renewed confrontation with the US could reach "the heart of Europe."

stories.title: Euro zone inflation hits 4%, a three-year high, as energy costs surge
stories.summary: Euro zone inflation climbed to 4% in October, its highest level in three years, with energy inflation near 21% complicating the European Central Bank's path on interest rates.

stories.title: Democrats win control of both houses of Congress in midterm rout
stories.summary: Democrats captured the Senate and House as voters delivered a blistering rebuke to President Trump, giving the party power to challenge his agenda through subpoenas, confirmation votes and legislation.

stories.title: Russia strike on Ukraine aid centre kills 33, more than 50 still trapped
stories.summary: At least 33 people were killed and dozens remain buried after Russian glide bombs hit a school used as a humanitarian aid centre in Zaporizhzhia, an attack Zelensky called one of the war's largest mass killings.

stories.title: Apple begins Apple Intelligence trial in China, powered by Alibaba's Qwen
stories.summary: Apple started a long-delayed developer trial of its AI tools for Chinese users, relying on Alibaba's Qwen model to comply with local rules nearly two years after the features launched in the US.

stories.title: OpenAI says ChatGPT search volume is about 20% of Google's
stories.summary: OpenAI says search-like queries through ChatGPT now run at roughly a fifth of Google's volume, with 1.2 billion weekly active users, as the chatbot keeps eroding Google's search dominance.

stories.title: Browns news roundup: Cleveland heads to New Orleans at 5-3
stories.summary: Cleveland's Nov. 4 daily roundup recaps the Browns' week as the 5-3 team prepares for Sunday's road game against the Saints, looking to rebound from a 27-6 loss at Pittsburgh.

stories.title: Ryan Day says everything is up for evaluation after Ohio State's 2nd loss
stories.summary: Day said "we're not allowed to lose games" after the 30-18 defeat at USC dropped the 6-2 Buckeyes from No. 2 to No. 11, with Oregon visiting Ohio Stadium on Saturday.

stories.title: Day backs Jeremiah Smith's frustration as receiver adjusts to life without Sayin
stories.summary: Day defended star receiver Jeremiah Smith's visible frustration in the USC loss, calling him "the ultimate competitor" as Smith adjusts to playing without injured quarterback Julian Sayin.

stories.title: Esteban Ocon's F1 career may be ending after abrupt Haas exit
stories.summary: Ocon's sudden departure from Haas, with reserve Rafael Camara set to make his F1 debut in Brazil, increasingly looks like the end of the Frenchman's decade-long Formula 1 career.

stories.title: Mercedes admits it 'let him down' over Russell's Mexico GP battery failure
stories.summary: A battery deployment failure on the run to Turn 1 wrecked George Russell's Mexico City Grand Prix, and Mercedes took the blame after he salvaged a sixth-place finish.

stories.title: Both Columbus Issue 8 and Issue 9 pass, paving way for council shake-up
stories.summary: Columbus voters approved both Issue 8 and Issue 9 on Tuesday, results that clear the way for a major shake-up of Columbus City Council.

stories.title: Sherrod Brown wins Ohio U.S. Senate race, defeating Jon Husted
stories.summary: Democrat Sherrod Brown defeated Jon Husted to win Ohio's U.S. Senate seat, returning to Washington as part of a decisive blue wave across the state.

stories.title: Amy Acton elected Ohio governor, first woman and first Democrat in 16 years
stories.summary: Amy Acton defeated Vivek Ramaswamy to become Ohio's first woman elected governor and the first Democrat to win the office in 16 years.
